question: By means of balance-sheet assessment 2023-20251, the Lombardy Region has replaced Article 26 of Regional Law 26/1993, which, in contrast to Article 5(7) of National Law 157/92, allows the replacement of non-removable leg rings fitted on live decoys used for hunting with small plastic bands that can easily be tampered with.
This move completely undermines efforts to combat illegal trafficking of live decoys caught unlawfully in the wild and lets off the hook individuals in possession of birds fitted with fake rings.

It also issued Decision XII/1849 of 5 February 2024, setting up an empty decoy database without any traceability and without any obligation to enter the identification number on the rings of captive-bred birds or of the aforementioned new bands, which will be distributed soon.

The Commission has initiated EU Pilot procedure 2023/10542 against Italy for violating the EU rules on hunting2, including by failing to implement the action plan for tackling offences committed against wild birds. Lombardy is one of Italy’s seven poaching ‘black spots’.

Can the Commission therefore clarify whether it intends to consider launching a formal infringement procedure against Italy concerning EU Pilot procedure 2023/10542, specifically for the illegal capture, killing and trade in birds, given the systematic violations of the Birds Directive?
(Regional Law 2/2023). the Birds Directive (2009/147/EEC).
